#380. Doctor Who Star Peter Capaldi Knows How To Save The Struggling Sci-Fi Series

📅 13 Nov 2026

Doctor Who Star Peter Capaldi Knows How To Save The Struggling Sci-Fi Series

Tanggal: 13 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.slashfilm.com/2313324/doctor-who-star-peter-capaldi-how-save-sci-fi-series/

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, as "doctor who" fans (aka whovians) are no doubt aware, the show is in a bit of a bind. The character, you see, is a time-traveling alien known as a Time Lord, and when they die, they're able to regenerate into a new person. Since its debut way back in 1963, the series has sustained itself with a clever sci-fi concept that has allowed multiple actors to canonically play the title role of the Doctor. Each time the Doctor regenerates, their personality changes a bit, although they still have the same memories, intellect, and enthusiasm.

Sebagaimana diketahui, unfortunately, after running for so long, "doctor who" has developed a bad habit of falling back on stale tropes. A Whovian friend of mine has agreed that "Doctor Who" is in a bad place right now, and the franchise's future is uncertain in the wake of Disney ending its partnership with the show due to its relatively low viewership. As my friend put it, the series is, indeed, in a "tepid" place, and no one knows where it will go moving forward.

Berdasarkan laporan, peter capaldi, however, has some suggestions. The actor, who played the Twelfth Doctor from 2014 to 2017, shared his ideas during his recent appearance on the "Half the Picture" podcast, explaining that he thinks the show needs to get back to basics. He added that it would do well to reorient itself by returning to its lower budgeted origins and tapping back into the shoddy charms of its earliest days.

Sebagaimana diketahui, in the same interview, peter capaldi clarified that he is fine with no longer being associated with "doctor who," as there are other ventures he would like to pursue. "Doctor Who," he noted, is the kind of show that takes over your life, adding, "You can't do it [. ] as a part-time role. " When it comes to the property's future, though, Capaldi is uncertain, stating:.

Sebagaimana diketahui, "what it's got to be, i don't know. That's what I grew up with. I was thinking about this [. ' I mean, 'Doctor Who' has always had ambition, it's just that budgets haven't always met that. Because my love for the show was the old show. Let's make it black-and-white with very wobbly sets. Or with less ambition. And that's not going to work. ] I don't know what people want from it. Let's make more cheaply. I can't come in and say 'Let's set it in the '60s. ".

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, capaldi then mused out loud if audiences might want "david and kylie. Or maybe they're more interested in previous "Doctor Who" stars like Christopher Eccleston or Jodie Whitaker. " He was, of course, referring to David Tennant's highly popular iteration of the Doctor appearing with a character played by Kylie Minogue on "Doctor Who" in the 2007 Christmas special "Voyage of the Damned" (which brought in an impressive number of viewers). Basically, Capaldi is very unsure what fans really want out of the series.

Sebagaimana diketahui, all he can say is that he enjoys "doctor who" the best when it experiences what he calls a "ripple" from the old show. Not a reused monster, necessarily, but a specific tone that sometimes breaks through. Something humble and old-fashioned.

Sebagaimana diketahui, although "doctor who" is a time-travel series that involves aliens, monsters, major historical figures, and ineffable, universe-ending technologies, peter capaldi feels that it's actually a "small" show. It's about a small group of characters and their time-traveling TARDIS, which looks like a police box that, via advanced technology, is larger on the inside than on the outside. Capaldi added that if the series could focus on those basics, it could sing once again, explaining:.

Diungkapkan bahwa "it's the doctor and the assistant-slash-assistants in the tardis. And like in 'The Lion, the Witch and the Wardrobe,' they step out the door to this drama. Quite contained. Magical, strange, weird, sad. It's that central core of that small group of people with the Doctor at the center of it. And those dramas change shape, and they've got monsters in them. Kind of balming. ".

Diungkapkan bahwa i have personally watched enough of the show to know that most of the best "doctor who" episodes embody what capaldi talked about. The problem, then, is that many of the series' seasonal storylines climax with some sort of supervillain threatening to destroy the universe, unwrite history, or commit some other kind of massive sci-fi cataclysm. And if those types of cataclysms are regularly happening, then it's no surprise that fans are experiencing a sense of fatigue (or that the show's creatives may be running low on ideas).

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, time will tell if the minds currently behind "doctor who" take capaldi's advice and scale the series back into a cheaper, more humble form. It certainly wouldn't hurt, what with the series being adrift following its short-lived Disney era and the planned 2026 Christmas special being canceled. Capaldi might just be onto something.

#382. 10 New Movies to Watch This Weekend on Netflix, Prime Video, and HBO Max (November 13 - 15)

📅 13 Nov 2026

10 New Movies to Watch This Weekend on Netflix, Prime Video, and HBO Max (November 13 - 15)

Tanggal: 13 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.polygon.com/new-movies-streaming-this-weekend-netflix-november-13-15/

A big horror movie, one of the best dinosaur movies of the year, and more.

Happy weekend! Several movies are hitting theaters this week, from the action-comedy How to Rob a Bank, starring Nicholas Hoult, Zoë Kravitz, and Christian Slater, to Ti West’s take on A Christmas Carol, titled Ebenezer and starring Johnny Depp.

Berdasarkan laporan, if that’s not enough to get you into theaters, we understand. Thankfully, Polygon has a full slate of new movie recommendations, available on streaming and VOD. The End of Oak Street is available on HBO Max, taking the crown for the best dinosaur movie since Steven Spielberg's Jurassic Park. It also has one of the scariest T-Rexes ever captured on film. Heart of the Beast is now available on VOD, following Brad Pitt and an adorable German Shepherd as they try their best to survive the harsh Alaskan wilderness.

Sebagaimana diketahui, if you’re looking for netflix dramas, there’s heartland, a musical-crime-western mashup starring jessica chastain and garrett hedlund. There’s also Chris Rock’s latest feature, Misty Green, following an out-of-work actress in Los Angeles desperate to make a career comeback. If you're into documentaries, there’s Avedon, exploring the life of career of the life of the beloved photographer whose work left a big imprint on fashion photography.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, lastly, being heumann, based on the autobiography of judy heumann’s life as an activist, is now streaming on apple tv. There’s also a new 4K reissue of one of Guillermo del Toro’s most beloved movies, Pan’s Labyrinth.

Diungkapkan bahwa david robert mitchell’s the end of oak street is an incredible riff on spielberg’s jurassic park, following a family in the '80s going through some personal challenges. As the parents contemplate a divorce, their neighborhood gets hurled back in time to the dinosaur era, with the outside of their home crawling with all sorts of terrifying pre-historic reptiles.

Diungkapkan bahwa the dinosaurs themselves are magnificent, rendered with the feathers and fuzzy hair that we now know dinosaurs sported without losing the fearsome nature imbued by spielberg 30 years ago. This is a movie where dinosaurs repeatedly slaughter and eat random humans, and each kill got an applause from my theater's rowdy audience every time. Mitchell and his team also take some creative swings with the creature designs that largely pay off, including a family of large rocky turtles and a terrifying silent serpent as long as a train with rows of impossibly sharp teeth.

Diungkapkan bahwa heartland is one of the strangest movies in jessica chastain’s career. The Oscar-winner plays Misty Jones, a former country megastar who returns home to Nashville to investigate the sudden disappearance of her niece, Charlie Hart, who’s following in her footsteps as a country musician.

Sebagaimana diketahui, being heumann is based on judy heumann's memoir, "being heumann: an unrepentant memoir of a disability rights activist," dramatizing the 28-day sit-in protest at the san francisco federal building by disability activists. The demonstration led to the first U. S. federal civil rights protections for people with disabilities.

Berdasarkan laporan, ron howard’s most recent film is a documentary centered on richard avedon, one of the most important photographers in fashion history. The film has great access to Avedon’s personal files, showing never-before-seen images and interviews with family members and figures like Twiggy, Isabella Rossellini, and more.

Berdasarkan laporan, misty green follows a once-successful actress and performer whose career has been derailed due to addiction, self-sabotage, and an evolving, challenging industry. After facing challenges from all sides, Misty goes on a desperate job hunt, pursuing a starring role in a remake of the musical Dreamgirls.

Sebagaimana diketahui, heart of the beast follows brad pitt as a traumatized soldier who gets stranded in the alaskan wilderness alongside his combat-trained german shepard. The two band together to survive and return to civilization.

Sebagaimana diketahui, two isolated middle-aged siblings' lives (gayle rankin and grant o’rourke) are disrupted when they receive an eviction notice from the government. Raised to view all outsiders as threats, the siblings are shocked by the arrival of a mild-mannered land recovery coordinator (Domhnall Gleeson), who doesn’t know how to communicate with them.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, pan’s labyrinth is a special film in guillermo del toro’s filmography, and his most direct exploration of fairy tales. The series is set in the aftermath of the Spanish Civil War and follows Ofelia (Ivana Baquero), a 12-year-old girl who’s just moved to a military outpost managed by her terrifying stepfather (Sergi Lopez). She uncovers a rich fantasy world after stumbling upon a labyrinth and a faun, who informs her that she’s the reincarnation of a Princess and must complete three tasks to return to her kingdom.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, after terrifying everyone with its amazing trailer, other mommy is finally available on streaming. The film follows Bela (Arabella Olivia Clark), the daughter of parents who are going through a marital crisis. She starts to form a relationship with a malignant shapeshifting entity that calls itself Other Mommy.

Sebagaimana diketahui, v/h/s mixtape is the latest entry in the vhs franchise, a found-footage horror anthology that has featured directors like ti west, adam wingard, scott derrickson, and more. This year’s version is centered on the music industry and framed in the style of an MTV news show.

#383. ‘The Rings of Power’ Officially Confirms the Moment Fans Have Waited 3 Seasons to See

📅 13 Nov 2026

‘The Rings of Power’ Officially Confirms the Moment Fans Have Waited 3 Seasons to See

Tanggal: 13 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://collider.com/the-rings-of-power-season-3-sauron-one-ring-forging/

Berdasarkan laporan, for two seasons, the lord of the rings: the rings of power has been meandering a bit while getting to the most pivotal moment in the history of middle-earth. We've seen Sauron manipulate the people of Middle-earth, adopt different identities, and assemble the pieces of a plan that will eventually threaten the entire world. But until now, there's been one particular piece of jewelry missing.

Sebagaimana diketahui, speaking exclusively with collider's maggie lovitt, the rings of power co-showrunner patrick mckay has confirmed that season 3 will feature sauron forging the one ring, one of the most consequential events in j. Tolkien's entire mythology. R. R. During an interview for Collider Behind the Scenes, McKay told Lovitt:.

Diungkapkan bahwa "the way that j. , my co-showrunner, and I do this is what felt natural to us when we first started talking to Amazon about the show. And then really the work that we do is taking those fixed points, whether it's the forging of the One Ring — that's a big moment this season. We looked at the text, we looked at the history of this particular era of the mythology, and there were these series of events that to us felt like they could lead one right into the next, right into the next, and build momentum with an audience the way that a serialized show should. D. ".

It's a major development for the series, particularly because the One Ring will eventually become the object at the center of both The Hobbit and The Lord of the Rings.

Berdasarkan laporan, in tolkien's mythology, sauron forges the one ring in the fires of mount doom, creating an object capable of dominating the other rings of power and extending his influence across middle-earth. Its creation sets in motion a chain of events that will eventually lead to the War of the Last Alliance and, thousands of years later, Frodo Baggins' journey to destroy it. It's because of all of that that The Rings of Power has more of a goal in mind this time around. McKay told Collider:.

Sebagaimana diketahui, "this is the season where sauron makes the one ring. So weirdly, for us, it all feels of a piece. We never get lost. Everything should tie into that. We are constantly trying to do less, not more. And if it doesn't, even if it delights us, maybe that's not the time for that story. ".

Diungkapkan bahwa the lord of the rings: the rings of power season 3 is streaming on prime video. Stay tuned to Collider for all the latest news and updates on the biggest and best movies and shows heading to your favorite streaming platforms soon.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, epic drama set thousands of years before the events of j. R. R. Tolkien's 'The Hobbit' and 'The Lord of the Rings' follows an ensemble cast of characters, both familiar and new, as they confront the long-feared re-emergence of evil to Middle-earth.

#384. Catherine Zeta-Jones’ Daughter Carys Wears Mom’s Gucci Top to Event

📅 13 Nov 2026

Catherine Zeta-Jones’ Daughter Carys Wears Mom’s Gucci Top to Event

Tanggal: 13 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.eonline.com/news/1438092/catherine-zeta-jones-daughter-carys-wears-moms-gucci-top?cmpid=rss-syndicate-genericrss-us-top_stories

Catherine Zeta-Jones’ daughter Carys Douglas, 23, wore a vintage Gucci top her mom first wore back in 1996.

Carys Douglas has no reservations about borrowing from her mom’s closet.

In fact, when the 23-year-old stepped out to the Gucci x Moda Operandi event in New York City on November 11, she did so in a vintage top from the designer brand her mom Catherine Zeta-Jones wore back in the ‘90s.

Diungkapkan bahwa the black lace top in question features a snap at the chest and features long sleeves. Carys styled the semi-sheer garment with a lacy black miniskirt, tights and a Gucci purse.

Diungkapkan bahwa back in 1996, however, catherine—who shares carys with husband michael douglas in addition 26-year-old son dylan michael douglas—opted for a set, pairing the top with matching lacy leggings, a black bag and black heels. At the time, she donned the ensemble for the Los Angeles premiere of the film The Long Kiss Goodnight, which starred Geena Davis and Samuel L. Jackson.

As for Carys, she’s previously admitted she doesn’t mind donning the mask of Catherine when it comes to fashion.

Sebagaimana diketahui, “i love vintage clothes,” she told people in october 2025. “I’m not really into fast fashion stuff, just for sustainability reasons, so I feel very lucky that I have a wonderful closet that I can pick from. ”.

Diungkapkan bahwa as for whether her mom was privy to her closet raids, carys admitted, “i should probably tell her more, because i snag a little too much. I don’t think so. She’s like, ‘Is that my bag?’ I’m like, ‘I don’t know. ’”.

Berdasarkan laporan, as for where her own career takes her, the brown university graduate noted, “i grew up doing theater, and i didn’t study acting in school, but that’s why i’m happy to be in such an informative arts space, so hopefully more of that. ”.

Diungkapkan bahwa which is why she was more than ready to accompany her dad to the nov. 4 Art of Freedom Gala 2026 in New York City, where he was honored with the Lifetime Achievement Award by the Tibet House US for his decades of peace advocacy.

Carys’ brother Dylan joined the father-daughter pair for the evening, making the event a truly special family affair for Michael, who is also dad to son Cameron, 47, with ex-wife Diandra Luker.

Diungkapkan bahwa "a wonderful night in nyc with @carys. "Thank you to @tibethouse. us for honoring me with the Art of Freedom Award. douglas and @dylan__douglas," the Basic Instinct star wrote on Instagram at the time. Truly grateful for this special recognition and for such a memorable evening!".

As for more stars who share special bonds with their kids, read on.

Teyana Taylor, Junie Shumpert & Rue Shumpert.

Looking more like sisters, there's one resemblance after another between the Oscar nominee and her daughters, who she shares with NBA alum Iman Shumpert.

#386. Johnny Depp’s ‘Ebenezer’ Makes a Weak Case for His Post-Trial Comeback

📅 13 Nov 2026

Johnny Depp’s ‘Ebenezer’ Makes a Weak Case for His Post-Trial Comeback

Tanggal: 13 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.vanityfair.com/story/ebenezer-johnny-depp-comeback

Sebagaimana diketahui, for weeks, los angeles has been plastered with posters of a malevolent-looking man in a top hat and gray sideburns. It always takes me a few minutes to process that this elderly curmudgeon is Johnny Depp, doing his Hollywood walk of shame in Ebenezer.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, “it’s good to be back,” depp gurgles in the movie’s trailer. He’s either reveling in his return from infamy or trolling the audience, depending on your point of view.

Sebagaimana diketahui, i adored johnny depp back in his edward scissorhands/gilbert grape/ed wood heyday; he probably would’ve been my hall pass if i’d known about the concept back then. Now, though, it feels as if the once chiseled-cheeked heartthrob has found a character that suits him: a monstrous figure seeking redemption.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, “grant me the grace to prove that i am no longer the man that i once was,” ebenezer scrooge begs one of the ghosts haunting him in this rather plodding new version of charles dickens’s a christmas carol, directed by horror auteur ti west. Scrooge is trying to make up for a lifetime of stinginess and cruelty, whereas Depp seeks to win back mainstream audiences after the ugly, drawn-out brawl that was his marriage and divorce from Amber Heard.

Sebagaimana diketahui, heard alleged that he was an abusive addict. Depp denied abusing her and filed two defamation suits. He aimed one at the British tabloid The Sun for calling him a wife-beater (which he lost, since the court found the characterization to be “substantially true”). The other was leveled at Heard for describing herself in a Washington Post op-ed as “a public figure representing domestic abuse. ” What started as a defamation trial ended up as a livestreamed referendum on post-#MeToo gender politics.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the saga spawned organized smear campaigns soaked in misogyny. It seemed to echo one of Depp’s texts about Heard, released during the trial, in which he proposed to a friend: “Let’s drown her before we burn her!!!…I will fuck her burnt corpse afterwards to make sure she is dead. Social media erupted with vile memes, hashtags, and videos targeting Heard, bearing hashtags like #AmberHeardIsAPsychopath and #DontBelieveAllWomen. ” And it wasn’t just ordinary guys taking up arms for Depp. One men’s group launched a “Ditch the Witch” protest in support of Depp. Moments after the verdict was announced, the GOP’s House Judiciary tweeted a GIF of Depp in Pirates of the Caribbean from its official account, showing support for him.

Berdasarkan laporan, “the craziness [aimed at heard] was a kind of pent-up anger at women,” a film producer suggested to me back in 2022. “I think it really stirred up a lot of deep-seated resentment that hasn’t been allowed expression since #MeToo. ”.

Berdasarkan laporan, depp didn’t come out of the crucible with his career intact. Still, he never really went away. In fact, like so many guys who have been supposedly “canceled,” he wormed his way back in quite easily. The next year, he directed the movie Modì, Three Days on the Wing of Madness. He was asked to resign from the Fantastic Beasts franchise—though Warner Bros. Meanwhile, producer Jerry Bruckheimer confirmed in 2025 that he’s been talking to Depp about a sixth Pirates film after all. still paid Depp his full $16 million salary—and his former agent claimed Disney dropped him from the next Pirates of the Caribbean movie. In 2023, he got a standing ovation at Cannes for his role as Louis XV in the French film Jeanne du Barry. All the while, Depp has also kept his massive brand deal as the face of Dior’s Sauvage.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, “i don’t feel boycotted by hollywood because i don’t think about hollywood,” depp announced imperiously a few years back. ” Enter Ebenezer, his official return to…Hollywood. “I don’t have much further need for Hollywood. Which he doesn’t need or think about. At all.

Sebagaimana diketahui, call it christmas-washing: what could be more wholesome and uncontroversial than a christmas carol? according to variety, paramount paid depp just $5 million—a big drop-off from the days when he could reportedly command $50 million for a single film—and only spent $38 million to produce the movie, hedging its bets. Still, this film is a pretty warm welcome back to American movie screens, major marketing campaign and all.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, unfortunately, depp’s mediocre performance in ebenezer doesn’t dispel the sour scent of desperation that hangs over his career. Scrooge is one of the most unlovable characters in all of literature, and Depp’s charm does not shine through the gnarled facial prosthetics. Depp’s inspiration for the role might as well have been Oscar the Grouch, though one with less educational value who’s hollow at his core. He plays the archetypal miser in the broadest of ways, spending much of the nearly two-hour movie alternating between exaggerated expressions of cantankerousness and horror. At various points, the actor campily throws himself into physical comedy that is at odds with the horror-soaked vibe of West’s production.

Sebagaimana diketahui, knowing this is a test run for depp’s uncanceling, viewers will find it hard not to see ebenezer as a wink-filled plea for absolution. “Allow me my redemption. “I’m not the man I was!” his character screams over and over. ” To which the answer—or my answer, at least—is simple: Bah, humbug.

#387. How To Rob A Bank Director Reveals The Real-Life Inspirations Behind The Movie's Influencers [Exclusive]

📅 13 Nov 2026

How To Rob A Bank Director Reveals The Real-Life Inspirations Behind The Movie's Influencers [Exclusive]

Tanggal: 13 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.slashfilm.com/2315149/how-to-rob-a-bank-director-influencers-real-life-inspirations/

Diungkapkan bahwa of all the movies in 2026 that can claim to be the timeliest, none may have a better case than "how to rob a bank. " Even setting aside the obvious social and political commentary behind director David Leitch's newest heist flick, in which a group of Robin Hood-like bank robbers team up to send a message to corporate bigwigs and capitalist vultures, the movie's timeliness is also apparent in the way it's shot and edited. The various trailers have made no secret of the content creator angle behind this crew, led by Nicholas Hoult's Ryan (aka The Wolf). When they're not sticking up banks and making thrilling getaways, they're busy editing their escapades into viral-ready YouTube videos to be consumed by the masses.

Sebagaimana diketahui, it's a novel approach that'll either work or not for audiences, many of whom are well aware of the online ecosystem that is influencer culture. During a recent press junket for the film, I spoke to both Leitch and producing partner Kelly McCormick about the deep well of influences they drew from in order to nail this specific element of the film — one that certainly attempts to feel true to our digital lives. It's a tall task for any mainstream Hollywood movie to tackle, but the creative team behind "How to Rob a Bank" clearly did their homework. According to McCormick:.

Diungkapkan bahwa "we were trying to go for what might be the next push for creators, if you know what i mean. Like, the wish fulfillment aspect from a creator's perspective of just pushing the envelope even more. So it was just really absorbing as much as possible to see what was out there and then using some of the prosumer cameras to make sure that we were just being even more wild. ".

Sebagaimana diketahui, the content creator footage depicted throughout "how to rob a bank" will inevitably leave an impression. (Not yet, at least. No, we don't live in a world where adrenaline-seeking influencers actually put themselves and others in harm's way to pull off successful heists and robberies. ) But actually capturing those vibes in an authentic way meant resorting to some very specific filmmaking measures.

Sebagaimana diketahui, one scene shows ryan and his friends fleeing the scene of the crime on motorcycles through a forest, with gopros strapped to their helmets capturing footage in every direction. When this is filtered through the lens of the video they upload afterwards, well, that's where things get visually dynamic. As Kelly McCormick explained to me:.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, "the one [scene] in specific i always remember is when they're biking through the forest and you see it from above and we are pivoting the camera in editorial, because literally it's capturing [360 degrees] around [the action]. And so you can spin it around in editorial to get that vibe of this wild editing that I think would be a creator's dream, if they didn't have to hit deadlines and always be feeding as much as possible to their hungry, hungry followers [laughs]. ".

Sebagaimana diketahui, david leitch name-checks "extreme sports" as one section of youtube they paid particular attention to for sequences like that, while the idea of philanthropy and giving back to communities was taken out of the mr. Even podcasters get into the mix, like Scott Galloway or King Bach (both of whom make cameos in the film). Beast playbook. Adds Leitch with a laugh, "We had a lot of influences in our influencers. ".

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the odyssey, one of the highest-grossing films of the 2026 movie schedule, is a serious movie that blends mythological themes and modern storytelling as it explores the journey of odysseus as he faces a dangerous voyage through fantastical realms on his way back to his family. And its director, Christopher Nolan, is a revered filmmaker known for paying attention to little details as he brings his signature narrative and visual style to life on the big screen. That doesn’t mean hilarious behind-the-scenes moments and shenanigans don’t still happen during production, and one in particular involves Tom Holland requesting skirt alterations.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the fantasy epic marked tom holland’s first time working with the filmmaker, and boy does he have some memorable stories to share from the experience. For example, according to Variety, who was at the November 10 FYC event, the current Spider-Man decided to take matters of his skirt into his own hands with costume designer Ellen Mirojnick, asking her to hem it to help give him some height on screen.

Berdasarkan laporan, in the 75-minute documentary behind the scenes of the odyssey, chronicling the making of the three-hour blockbuster, holland revealed that his reasoning for the change didn’t matter because you can’t sneak anything by christopher nolan. He said:.

I asked Ellen, the costume designer, I said, ‘Could you just make the skirt a little shorter?’ It’ll make me look a little taller.

Estimated to fall somewhere between 5’6” and 5’8”, I can absolutely understand wanting to appear as tall as possible while starring in such a big movie.

Sebagaimana diketahui, i also appreciate that the peter parker actor has enough self-awareness to make such a request. Apparently, he even got the request fulfilled when the costume designer had his tailored skirt ready six weeks later. #394. Johnny Depp's Ebenezer Makes An Alarming Change To The Story Of A Christmas Carol

📅 13 Nov 2026

Johnny Depp's Ebenezer Makes An Alarming Change To The Story Of A Christmas Carol

Tanggal: 13 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.slashfilm.com/2315819/johnny-depp-ebenezer-a-christmas-carol-story-change/

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, when the ads and pre-release buzz articles began running for "ebenezer," the new film directed by ti west and starring johnny depp as scrooge, the campaign promised that the movie would present charles dickens' "a christmas carol" as you'd never seen it before. The movie liberally copy-and-pastes whole swathes of Dickens' text into the script, with writer Nathaniel Halpern even bothering to include the novella's separation into five staves. Yet, now that the film has released and folks (including yours truly) have screened it, it turns out "Ebenezer" is unsurprisingly more or less the same "A Christmas Carol" we all know well. However, it seems there's some larger artistic liberty wiggle room in that "more or less the same" than might appear at first glance.

Sebagaimana diketahui, when west spoke to entertainment weekly back in august, he detailed what made depp's ebenezer different than previous adaptations. Amidst talking up things like Depp's "musicality" as a performer, West also explained how his film would present Scrooge in a more both sides-y manner: "As [Depp's] Scrooge cuts someone down verbally or as he makes a financial point or withdraws, you do understand why he's doing it. " That offhand mention of "a financial point" baffled many of us when we first read it, as it certainly did sound like a deviation from Dickens.

Diungkapkan bahwa was this scrooge going to be portrayed as a genius businessman? instead, the changes "ebenezer" makes to scrooge and dickens' story are of a smaller nature. They involve portraying a couple small supporting characters as outright villains, thereby giving Scrooge a justification for his misanthropy. The changes may be merely tweaks, yet their larger implications are alarming, especially for a film which doesn't feel able to support them.

Diungkapkan bahwa for the most part, "ebenezer" is a faithful adaptation of "a christmas carol. Marley goes to get some tea while Scrooge observes a beggar outside his window. " The largest addition comes in the form of a prologue in which we see Scrooge and his partner, Jacob Marley (Ian McKellen), on their last day together. At the same moment the beggar reveals himself to Scrooge as a fraud conning people out of their donations, Marley drops dead, equating the con artist's crime with harm done to a true earner in Scrooge's mind. That Marley (and Scrooge) are just as heartless and dishonest is something the film hopes Dickens' work gets across, as they don't go out of their way to underline it to support their addition.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, this problem is compounded twice. Once is when it's revealed that Scrooge's old benevolent boss Fezziwig was murdered by a street beggar, further teaching Scrooge that charity can be met with violence. Next is when the Ghost of Christmas Future shows Scrooge the vultures who've come to sully his legacy after his death, which adds the wrinkle that the two men who sought a donation for the poor at the beginning of the film are actually also embezzlers.

Sebagaimana diketahui, what's more, they're in league with a man who's plotting with the embezzlers to steal scrooge's nephew fred's inheritance with the production of a forged will. The alarming quality about these inclusions lies in how they seem to give Scrooge more moral justification for his odious behavior that he doesn't need. It's a bizarrely tone-deaf addition for a story that's ultimately meant to be about the virtues of charity.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, ultimately (and thankfully), these additions do not derail "ebenezer," for the heart of charles dickens' story and his themes remains intact. Although it's tempting to point fingers at the Skydance corporation for the new ideas, it isn't the changes themselves that are the problem. "Ebenezer" is indeed partially constructed to emphasize the horror in Dickens' tale: the three Christmas ghosts are more ghastly and doomed than they typically are. After all, Ti West comes from a background of indie horror films, many of which utilize thorny, morally ambiguous characterizations and themes as their stock in trade. In the more horror-centric version of "A Christmas Carol" the movie seems to want to be, a somewhat justified Scrooge would be a fascinating layer for an actor to play, as it creates a new obstacle for the character to overcome on his journey to selflessness.

Sebagaimana diketahui, alas, "ebenezer" is the johnny depp show, and for several reasons, depp is not up to the task. Instead, "Ebenezer" and Depp are too preoccupied with trying to be as likable as possible, which means that his Scrooge rarely gets nasty. He comes off more like an irritable jerk than a man who's nearly lost his soul, so whatever compelling shadings the changes to the story could've presented never materialize. While it's arguable that he may not be able to tackle such material at all, it seems like he's not even interested in trying in the first place. On paper, the possibilities presented by "Ebenezer" range from exciting to alarming. Yet we needn't fret too much, since the finished film plays things so safely that it's hard to get riled up about it one way or the other.
